description: This file declares the 'Archive' class and related functions for handling archive files, including extracting contents and images, within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: Archive
classes.description: A class providing operations on archive files such as listing contents and extracting files.

methods.name: Archive
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Archive object with a filename.

methods.name: Contents
methods.description: Returns a list of contents within the archive.

methods.name: ExtractAll
methods.description: Extracts all files from the archive to the specified directory.

methods.name: ExtractFiles
methods.description: Extracts specific files from the archive to the specified directory.

methods.name: ExtractToMemory
methods.description: Extracts a specific file from the archive into memory as a string.

methods.name: ExtractImages
methods.description: Extracts specified images from an archive to a target directory, optionally keeping the archive.

methods.name: ExtractImage
methods.description: Extracts a single image from an archive to a target directory, with an option to keep the archive.

methods.name: ExtractArchiveContents
methods.description: Extracts the contents of an archive to a target directory, optionally keeping the archive.
